headword: {折返|おりかえ}し{運転|うんてん}
gloss: shuttle operation; partial operation with turnback

definitions.gloss: shuttle operation; partial operation with turnback (trains, buses)
definitions.explanation: The practice of operating trains or buses only along part of a line and turning them back before the usual terminus, typically because a section further along is blocked by an accident, weather, or other disruption.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}のため{折返|おりかえ}し{運転|うんてん}となっている。
examples.english: Due to the accident, the line is running on shuttle operation.

examples.japanese: {大雨|おおあめ}で{一部|いちぶ}{区間|くかん}が{折返|おりかえ}し{運転|うんてん}になった。
examples.english: Due to the heavy rain, part of the line went to shuttle operation.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}{駅|えき}から{品川|しながわ}{駅|えき}までの{折返|おりかえ}し{運転|うんてん}が{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: Shuttle service is continuing between Tokyo Station and Shinagawa Station.

examples.japanese: {信号|しんごう}{故障|こしょう}の{影響|えいきょう}で、{新宿|しんじゅく}{駅|えき}での{折返|おりかえ}し{運転|うんてん}を{実施|じっし}しています。
examples.english: Due to a signal malfunction, we are operating shuttle service turning back at Shinjuku Station.

notes:
Composed of {折返|おりかえ}し (turning back, U-turn) + {運転|うんてん} (operation). A standard railway-announcement term in Japan used when a portion of a line is blocked and trains cannot run through to the normal terminus. Trains are instead operated back and forth between an intermediate station and one endpoint.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {折返|おりかえ}し{運転|うんてん}を{実施|じっし}する: to operate shuttle service
- {折返|おりかえ}し{運転|うんてん}となる: to go to shuttle operation
- {折返|おりかえ}し{運転|うんてん}{区間|くかん}: section under shuttle operation
- {折返|おりかえ}し{運転|うんてん}{中|ちゅう}: currently operating shuttle service

RELATED WORDS:
- {運休|うんきゅう}: service suspension — no trains running at all
- {間引|まび}き{運転|うんてん}: reduced service — fewer trains, not a turnback
- {直通|ちょくつう}{運転|うんてん}: through operation — the normal, full-route operation; the opposite concept
- {平常|へいじょう}{運転|うんてん}: normal operation — the baseline

USAGE:
Heard frequently in Japanese train-line status updates ("{山手線|やまのてせん}は{折返|おりかえ}し{運転|うんてん}を{実施|じっし}しています"). Passengers may need to change trains or use alternative routes beyond the turnback point.
